Date: Wed, 7 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure Marketplace private plan — evidence pack & onboarding timeline

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to get going on the Azure private plan so we can include Redwood in our procurement cadence next quarter. Legal asked me to gather the requested evidence and confirm an onboarding timeline.

Quick overview of what I have so far:
- High-level SOC2 attestation (summary) — attaching short PDF version now
- Sample SOW for initial POC — attaching
- Company legal entity details and tax form (coming from procurement team)

Two asks:
1) Can you send a checklist of the exact docs Redwood requires to publish the private plan in Azure (SOC2, DPA, PublisherID, sample contracts, any marketplace-specific onboarding forms)?
2) What is the realistic timeline from redlines to Marketplace publish if we aim for a private plan (not public listing)? We are targetting procurement close by end of May.

I attached a zip with the summary documents for now (MediQ-SOC2-summary.pdf, MediQ-POC-SOW.docx). Procurement inbox is procurement@mediqsys.com.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if easier.

—Anya

Date: Wed, 7 May 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace private plan — evidence pack & onboarding timeline

Anya — thanks for sending these over and for the clear ask. Looping in Karthik (sales) and Irene (legal/onboarding) so we can align on both procurement terms and the marketplace steps.

Attached is our standard marketplace onboarding checklist (evidence_checklist.xlsx) — short version below for quick reference:
- SOC2 Type II full report (or summary + auditor contact)
- Data Processing Addendum (signed or redline)
- Azure Publisher ID / existing MSP relationship details
- Company entity legal name + W-9/Tax form (for US customers)
- Sample SOW / POC statement of work
- Point of contact for technical onboarding + estimated capacity (GPU profile if dedicated)
- Any restricted data requirements (residency, encryption key management)

Timeline (rough):
- Receipt of complete evidence + signed DPA: 2 business days for validation
- Legal review / redlines on our MSA/Exhibit: 3–5 business days (depends on scope of changes)
- Azure Marketplace private plan setup and publisher onboarding: 5–7 business days after legal signoff (Azure queues can vary)

If procurement can provide the SOC2 full report (PDF) and entity tax form this week, we can start legal redlines immediately and aim to publish the private plan within 10 business days. If you want, we can put together a short mutual action plan and DocuSign link for signature.

Next steps I propose:
1) You drop full SOC2 and entity tax form to procurement@redwood.example.com and procurement@mediqsys.com (we'll confirm receipt).
2) We create a 20-minute sync tomorrow to walk onboarding tasks and agree on DPA/PO terms.

My calendar: https://cal.redwood.example.com/soojin  — I'll book tentatively if that helps.

—SoJin
SoJin Lee
Senior Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.example.com

(attachment: evidence_checklist.xlsx)

Anya — thanks for the quick turnaround and for flagging data residency. A few clarifications from the commercial side: 

- Net30 is fine for the initial POC invoice; we'll capture standard payment terms in the SOW. For the private plan listing we typically require a publisher billing contact and preferred invoicing flow (Marketplace vs direct invoice).
- For EU data residency: Redwood's private plan can be pinned to a region (westeurope) if you opt for our dedicated deployment option; that will require a dedicated capacity profile and may incur additional monthly charges (I'll get exact numbers from ops during the call). If you need BYOK/HSM for key control, we support KMS integrations but that is an add-on.
- I'll kick off the legal redline path — Irene, can you prepare the DPA + MSA redlines for MediQ? We'll aim to share an initial markup within 48 hours once Soojin confirms receipt of the full SOC2 and tax form.

Let's confirm the 10:30 PT sync — I've accepted the slot on Soojin's calendar. On the call we'll: 1) confirm evidence received, 2) agree payment/invoicing flow, 3) agree on timeline for redlines and marketplace publish.

Thanks — talk tomorrow.

—Karthik
